name: tikz-funfig
description: Create editable academic research figures, plots, frameworks, models, and flowcharts from descriptions, data, sketches, or existing TikZ.

interface.shortDescription: Turn research models and data into editable paper figures
interface.longDescription: Create academic 2D function/data plots, social-science and business research frameworks, mathematical or variable-relation models, flowcharts, and basic explanatory schematics from descriptions, data, sketches, reference images, or existing TikZ/PGFPlots source. Deliver editable LaTeX and PDF; request SVG when needed.
defaultPrompt: 查看 TIKZ-FunFig 能画哪些图，并给我每类图的示例说法。
根据我的数据绘制带单位和误差棒的学术图。
把下面的实验步骤画成有判断分支的流程图。
把自变量、中介变量、调节变量和结果变量整理成论文研究模型图。
把我的社会科学或商学研究方案整理成分层框架图。
帮我修改这份现有的 TikZ 或 PGFPlots 图。
